# pkc/lang

> pkc: the grammar assembled from the loaded syntax packages (port of NewLang).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/lang.pkg)

`lg_new(pkgs)` builds the statement, expression and operator tables, the
keywords, the symbols the lexer accepts and the block closers, from
syntax packages in name order. Nothing in it is built in.

```
struct LgRule
  pkg: ptr PfFile
  kind: str
  syn: ptr PfSyntax
  pat: ptr PfPattern
  tmpl: ptr Vec
end

struct Lang
  pkgs: ptr Map
  stmt_lit: ptr Map
  stmt_slot: ptr Vec
  expr_lit: ptr Map
  expr_slot: ptr Vec
  infix: ptr Map
  prefix: ptr Map
  postfix: ptr Map
  prims: ptr Map
  closers: ptr Map
  keywords: ptr Map
  puncts: ptr Vec
end

fn lg_rule(v: ptr Vec, i: int) -> ptr LgRule
  return vec_get(v, i) as ptr LgRule
end

// lg_rules is the list of rules stored under key, or null.
fn lg_rules(m: ptr Map, key: str) -> ptr Vec
  if !map_has(m, key)
    return null
  end
  return map_get(m, key) as ptr Vec
end

fn lg_add_rule(m: ptr Map, key: str, r: ptr LgRule)
  let v = lg_rules(m, key)
  if v == null
    v = vec_new()
    map_set(m, key, v as int)
  end
  vec_push(v, r as int)
end

fn lg_core_kind(k: str) -> bool
  return k == "block" || k == "int" || k == "str" || k == "var" || k == "ident" || k == "func" || k == "newfunc" || k == "args" || k == "params" || k == "program" || k == "type" || k == "field" || k == "fields" || k == "fielddecl" || k == "newtype" || k == "newconst" || k == "group" || k == "groups"
end

fn lg_is_word(s: str) -> bool
  if s == ""
    return false
  end
  let rs = lx_decode(s)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(rs) - 1
    let r = vec_get(rs, i)
    if !(lx_letter(r) || lx_digit(r) || r == 95)
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

// u_sort_strs sorts strings by bytes (insertion sort: the lists are short).
fn u_sort_strs(v: ptr Vec)
  for i = 1 to vec_len(v) - 1
    let x = vec_get(v, i)
    let j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 && str_cmp(vec_get(v, j) as str, x as str) > 0
      vec_set(v, j + 1, vec_get(v, j))
      j = j - 1
    end
    vec_set(v, j + 1, x)
  end
end

fn lg_fail(msg: str) -> ptr Lang
  pk_err = msg
  return null
end

fn lg_new(pkgs: ptr Vec) -> ptr Lang
  let L = new Lang
  L.pkgs = map_new()
  L.stmt_lit = map_new()
  L.stmt_slot = vec_new()
  L.expr_lit = map_new()
  L.expr_slot = vec_new()
  L.infix = map_new()
  L.prefix = map_new()
  L.postfix = map_new()
  L.prims = map_new()
  L.closers = map_new()
  L.keywords = map_new()
  L.puncts = vec_new()
  let type_owner = map_new()
  let punct = map_new()
  for pi = 0 to vec_len(pkgs) - 1
    let f = vec_get(pkgs, pi) as ptr PfFile
    let kind = pf_kind(f.name)
    if vec_len(f.syntax) > 0
      if lg_core_kind(kind)
        return lg_fail(u_cat4(f.origin, ": package name ", u_quote(kind), " is reserved by the compiler"))
      end
      if map_has(L.pkgs, kind)
        let other = map_get(L.pkgs, kind) as ptr PfFile
        return lg_fail(u_cat4("two loaded packages both define ", u_quote(kind), ": ", u_cat3(other.name, " and ", f.name)))
      end
      map_set(L.pkgs, kind, f as int)
    end
    for ti = 0 to vec_len(f.types) - 1
      let t = vec_get(f.types, ti) as ptr PfType
      if map_has(type_owner, t.name)
        return lg_fail(u_cat4("type ", t.name, " is declared by both ", u_cat3(map_get(type_owner, t.name) as str, " and ", f.name)))
      end
      map_set(type_owner, t.name, f.name as int)
      map_set(L.prims, t.name, t.size)
    end
    for si = 0 to vec_len(f.syntax) - 1
      let s = vec_get(f.syntax, si) as ptr PfSyntax
      for qi = 0 to vec_len(s.patterns) - 1
        let p = vec_get(s.patterns, qi) as ptr PfPattern
        let r = new LgRule
        r.pkg = f
        r.kind = kind
        r.syn = s
        r.pat = p
        let lits = pf_literals(p)
        for li = 0 to vec_len(lits) - 1
          let lit = u_get(lits, li)
          if lg_is_word(lit)
            map_set(L.keywords, lit, 1)
          else
            map_set(punct, lit, 1)
          end
        end
        let cl = pf_closers(p)
        for ci = 0 to vec_len(cl) - 1
          map_set(L.closers, u_get(cl, ci), 1)
        end
        let first = pf_elem(p.elems, 0)
        if s.kind == "infix" || s.kind == "prefix" || s.kind == "postfix"
          let table = L.infix
          let op = ""
          if vec_len(p.elems) > 1
            op = pf_elem(p.elems, 1).lit
          end
          if s.kind == "prefix"
            table = L.prefix
            op = first.lit
          elif s.kind == "postfix"
            table = L.postfix
          end
          let o = lg_rules(table, op)
          if o != null && vec_len(o) > 0
            let o0 = lg_rule(o, 0)
            if o0.pkg != f || o0.syn.prec != s.prec
              return lg_fail(u_cat4(s.kind, " operator ", u_quote(op), u_cat4(" is defined by both ", o0.pkg.name, " and ", f.name)))
            end
          end
          lg_add_rule(table, op, r)
        elif s.kind == "expr"
          if first.lit != ""
            lg_add_rule(L.expr_lit, first.lit, r)
          else
            vec_push(L.expr_slot, r as int)
          end
        else
          if first.lit != ""
            lg_add_rule(L.stmt_lit, first.lit, r)
          else
            vec_push(L.stmt_slot, r as int)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  // longer slot-first statement patterns are tried first (stable)
  for i = 1 to vec_len(L.stmt_slot) - 1
    let x = lg_rule(L.stmt_slot, i)
    let j = i - 1
    while j >= 0 && vec_len(lg_rule(L.stmt_slot, j).pat.elems) < vec_len(x.pat.elems)
      vec_set(L.stmt_slot, j + 1, vec_get(L.stmt_slot, j))
      j = j - 1
    end
    vec_set(L.stmt_slot, j + 1, x as int)
  end
  for i = 0 to map_len(punct) - 1
    u_push(L.puncts, map_key(punct, i))
  end
  u_sort_strs(L.puncts)
  if !lg_lex_all(L, L.stmt_slot) || !lg_lex_all(L, L.expr_slot)
    return null
  end
  let tables = vec_new()
  vec_push(tables, L.stmt_lit as int)
  vec_push(tables, L.expr_lit as int)
  vec_push(tables, L.infix as int)
  vec_push(tables, L.prefix as int)
  vec_push(tables, L.postfix as int)
  for ti = 0 to vec_len(tables) - 1
    let m = vec_get(tables, ti) as ptr Map
    for k = 0 to map_len(m) - 1
      if !lg_lex_all(L, map_value(m, k) as ptr Vec)
        return null
      end
    end
  end
  return L
end

fn lg_lex_all(L: ptr Lang, rules: ptr Vec) -> bool
  for i = 0 to vec_len(rules) - 1
    let r = lg_rule(rules, i)
    if r.pkg.expand != null && r.tmpl == null
      let toks = lx_lex(u_join(r.pkg.expand, "\n"), u_cat(r.pkg.name, " (expand)"), L.puncts, true)
      if toks == null
        return false
      end
      vec_pop(toks)
      r.tmpl = toks
    end
  end
  return true
end

// lg_forms counts the statement and expression patterns.
fn lg_forms(L: ptr Lang) -> int
  let n = vec_len(L.stmt_slot) + vec_len(L.expr_slot)
  for i = 0 to map_len(L.stmt_lit) - 1
    n = n + vec_len(map_value(L.stmt_lit, i) as ptr Vec)
  end
  for i = 0 to map_len(L.expr_lit) - 1
    n = n + vec_len(map_value(L.expr_lit, i) as ptr Vec)
  end
  return n
end
```
